explanations.title: Mark incomplete reviews
explanations.summary: The review scope now records whether the review finished successfully. Consumers can distinguish a complete review with no findings from one where a sub-agent or verification step failed.

explanations.title: Add repeat evaluations
explanations.summary: Adds `eval-run` to review cases from a repeat dataset. Before sending anything, it checks that every case’s commits are available; sending requires explicit `--yes` and an API key, while `--dry-run` previews cases without sending them.

explanations.title: Cap spend and preserve progress
explanations.summary: Reviews run case-by-case in rounds, with a total-spend guard that stops before another review could exceed the cap. Results are saved after each attempt, so `--resume` can continue with reviews not already recorded.

explanations.title: Produce an evaluation report
explanations.summary: After the available reviews, the command writes a Markdown score report alongside the per-review results. If the total cap stopped the evaluation, the report explains how to continue.

explanations.title: Exclude incomplete reviews from scoring
explanations.summary: A failed review or one marked incomplete is recorded with an error rather than scored as a review that found no bugs. Only completed reviews’ findings are passed to the scorer.

explanations.title: Expose the evaluation command
explanations.summary: The top-level CLI now dispatches `px1 eval-run` to the evaluation workflow and includes it in the usage command list.
